about: Golden set of smart extraction (plan acceptance criterion 5, decision 0018). For each text and learner level, the pre-selected candidates must be at least 55 % at the learner's level, at most 10 % one level above, the rest below, none higher, and none of the words the learner already has ('known': simulated notes / known terms). A vocabulary list must still yield every entry ('list_entries'). Checked by src/domain/candidates.golden.test.ts on the recordings in recorded/.
